title: opencode-session-end Evaluation Goldset
description: Published evaluation criterion for the OpenCode session_end → session.deleted fallback (ADR-479). Code-based grader on generator output.

cases.scenario: session_end-only manifest resolves with native fallback
cases.input_context: manifest { events: { session_end: [{ skill: "team-levelup", timeout: 120 }] } }, agent "opencode" via resolveEvents

cases.scenario: generated plugin carries both V1 and V2 session.deleted paths
cases.input_context: same manifest through installEvents("opencode", projectRoot, resolved, ".agents/skills")

cases.scenario: declared event vanishes with no error (the shipped bug)
cases.input_context: manifest from pass case 1 through resolveEvents with session_end: null mapping (pre-fix registry)
cases.expected_output: resolved == {} (session_end dropped) — FAIL: declared event must survive resolution
FAIL: exactly ONE "event" entry required (duplicate object keys drop a handler); both === branches (session.deleted + file.edited) must be present in that entry

cases.scenario: mapping regression — future edit reverts session_end to null
cases.expected_output: FAIL detected by pass case 1 assertion firing on undefined resolved.session_end

cases.scenario: guard collapse — subscriptions merged into one unguarded branch, or two "event" keys (duplicate-key drop)
cases.input_context: session_end + file_edited manifest, agent "opencode", generated V2 setup body
cases.expected_output: FAIL detected by single-entry + both-branch assertions (zero/two/unguarded entries all fail)

cases.scenario: V1-only regression — V2 setup loses session.deleted loop while V1 keeps working
cases.input_context: session_end-only manifest, agent "opencode", generated plugin V2 setup body
cases.expected_output: FAIL detected by V2 assertions (ctx.event.subscribe + session.deleted in setup); V1-only check would miss it
